# Message

A message is one turn element with a role (`user`, `assistant` or `system`), an optional `speaker` name and ordered content parts: `TextPart` and `AudioPart`. `Message.text` joins the text parts; the token partition splits it into Player (`knowledge/architecture/domain.md`) objects, the `messages` partition makes it one. Backends send a speaker as `"<speaker>: <text>"` (speaker rendering (`knowledge/decisions/Domain decisions.md`)). Audio parts are representable, but no backend accepts them yet (D02 - Audio backend (`knowledge/issues/D02 - Audio backend.md`)).

Package: domain (`knowledge/architecture/domain.md`).
